story.summaryEn:
The challenge of Macau! 🇲🇴
A rite of passage for future F1 stars, a nightmare to conquer. More than half of today’s Formula 1 drivers have raced through the streets of Macau, but only one has ever stood on the top step of the podium 👀🤯
#FIA #MacauGP
detailZh:
澳门的挑战！🇲🇴
对未来的F1明星来说是一种成人礼，征服它的噩梦。今天超过一半的F1车手都在澳门的街道上比赛过，但只有一位曾站在领奖台的最高处 👀🤯
#FIA #MacauGP
